card.name: Nouns after 'the following' before a colon
card.fires_on: The noun right after 'the following' (conditions, criteria, situations, manner) or 'described', where a colon or list is about to begin. Also a few other spots where a clause is complete and a punctuation mark comes next.

modes.label: Noun after 'the following'
modes.description: A list-introducing noun such as conditions, criteria or situations, followed by a colon and a list.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Carvedilol Tablet is contraindicated in the following<< conditions>>: • Bronchial asthma or related

modes.label: Phrase-ending word before punctuation
modes.description: A word that ends a clause, such as 'below' or 'administration', just before a bracket or period.
modes.example: that assessed the risk of VTE associated with the use of Etonogestrel and ethinyl estradiol vaginal ring are described<< below>>. In these studies, which were required

modes.label: Code or verse line end
modes.description: A word that completes a statement just before a semicolon or exclamation mark.
modes.example: Device::Arduino::LCD - Perl Interface to the PerLCD Arduino Sketch. use<< strict>>; use Device::Arduino::LCD;

card.writes: It favors closing punctuation, line breaks and code-fence tokens, and disfavors tokens that continue a code line.
card.plain: It fires on the last word of an intro phrase, like 'the following conditions', when a colon and list come next.
